m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Ah, Voltergeists in the Turbines again, hmm? Standard natural hazard around these parts. Usually we just draw them into these specially made Shells.
Yeah, they're nothing fancy, just raw Storm energy encapsulated in a wooden shell and sealed with Fangle Saliva.
I'm plum out of all that though. So if you want a Ghost Shell, you need to get me the ingredients. First battle Fangles for their Saliva.
I'll also need some of that Storm Energy that shoots off the Chain. I already put out bottles to catch it. You just need to collect them.
Finally, I need the Shell of the Hookworm. It lives in a tunnel in the Fields of Blue Grass. You'll have to defeat the Earworms outside to get in.
Well, you got your tasks. Get to 'em if you want that Ghost Shell.
Did you find everything? Now let me just take a look in your ear, make sure those worms didn't infect you with their catchy songs.
I try to maintain something of a more inquisitive outlook. Most Nimbari, the Vicereine included, like to believe we stand alone.
But you don't have to look too hard to find evidence to the contrary. Just take our power grid for example. It was built by local Aero Dwarves.
We use giant Turbines on the Aero Plains to funnel energy from the Storm strand of the Paradox Chain directly here.
But conditions down there have deteriorated, leading to increased problems up here. Even now Storm Turbine D is barely functioning.
Everyone is busy or scared, so I must ask you to investigate. I've patched into your Communicator. Go to the Plains and tell me what you see.
Please, Wizard, go to Storm Turbine D in the Northeast Aero Plains and tell me what you find.
